01 / Background

My background.
Why security interests me.

I enjoy finding out what changed, what the evidence shows, and what needs to happen next. That mindset started with how things break and get fixed, and it’s why I moved into security. I build it through hands-on labs and by leading a team in a fast-paced Amazon Air operation, where accuracy, clear communication, and following process under time pressure matter every shift. I’m now aiming for an entry-level SOC analyst role, where I can turn that habit of investigating into work that protects people and systems.

Technical operations.

Professional roles and responsibilities at Amazon Air.
